title: Elevated 5xx errors on cloud-api
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-05-07 10:41-15:31: cloud-api: 654 of 751 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-07 10:41 and 2026-05-07 15:31 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.983 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling <*> HTTPError: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable

_templates.macro: Terraform change halved {svc} task memory {old} -> {new} MB; tasks were OOM-killed under load and the service restarted in a loop.
_templates.remediation: Restore memory = {old} on {resource}; alarm on MemoryUtilization.

culprit.diff:
@@ -20,3 +20,3 @@ aws_ecs_task_definition.image_svc
 resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "image_svc" {
-  memory = 2048
+  memory = 1024
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change halved image-svc task memory 2048 -> 1024 MB; tasks were OOM-killed under load and the service restarted in a loop.
rca.remediation: Restore memory = 2048 on aws_ecs_task_definition.image_svc; alarm on MemoryUtilization.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `<*> <*> <*> HTTP/1.1" status: <*> len: <*> time: <*>`.
